name: Plant Biology and Conservation PhD
summary: Plant Biology and Conservation doctorate offered jointly with the Chicago Botanic Garden.
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed. Annual December 1 deadline illustrates Fall 2026. Mentor-selection admission model not established. Stipend is published for 2026–27.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application
publishedDeadlines.dateText: December 1 each year for following fall
publishedDeadlines.note: Official example December 1, 2025 for Fall 2026; no explicitly dated Fall 2027 deadline.

applicationFee.note: PBC offers limited first-come international low-income waivers: identify supporting potential PBC adviser, complete first three application pages and upload CV on page 10, then use linked form. Low income defined by US Department of Education; confirm documentation/eligibility. Separate central waivers require US citizenship/permanent residency plus listed first-generation/service/Pell/program criteria.

english.note: Central MET 61 accepted for PhD; DET and TOEFL Essentials excluded. Official results within two years of intended entry; Home Edition and IELTS Indicator accepted. English-primary undergraduate/graduate degree permits discretionary program/TGS waiver request after application, with documentation potentially required. TA/graduate-assistant funding English requirement separate.

documents: Online application with TGS standardized prompts
Transcripts from every academic institution; unofficial review accepted, official upon acceptance
Two recommendations; at least one familiar with academic/research experience
Academic Statement reproducing and answering four departmental prompts
Official English results unless waiver approved
requirements.note: Before enrollment: at least two biology/related environmental-science courses, one semester statistics, and one semester organic chemistry, genetics or ecology. Statement covers academic interests, preparation, program/goals fit, scholarly questions and named aligned faculty. All PhDs teach at least two quarters and maintain satisfactory academic progress.

funding.note: All accepted PhD students offered stipend, health insurance and no tuition over five years through fellowships/assistantships; academic progress required. Published stipend applies 2026–27, not confirmed Fall 2027 amount. The offer applies to all accepted PhD students, including international students.
